queries.query: large language model network configuration generation OR "intent to configuration" "network config" "LLM" OR "large language model"
queries.rationale: Locate primary work where LLMs are used to synthesize router/switch configurations or translate high-level intent into device configs to understand existing methods, failure reports, and evaluation approaches.
source_preferences: IEEE/ACM conferences (SIGCOMM, NSDI, SOSR, IMC, CNSM)

queries.query: LLM configuration repair OR "configuration repair" "large language model" "LLM" "network"
queries.rationale: Find work on automatic repair/patching of faulty network configs using generative models or generate-validate-repair loops to assess typical repair strategies and common failure modes.
Survey architectures that pair LLMs with external verifiers/tools (symbolic checkers, unit tests, validators) to bound or correct outputs—central to safe NetOps pipelines.
source_preferences: Systems venues discussing integration (USENIX, SOSP/OSDI workshops)

queries.query: network configuration verification Batfish "Header Space Analysis" NetPlumber Anteater "network verification"
queries.rationale: Collect seminal and recent deterministic/static-verification tools and methods (Batfish, HSA, NetPlumber, Veriflow) to use as validators or baselines and to understand what properties are provable versus heuristic.

Map work applying ML/LLMs to incident detection, diagnosis, and remediation in operations to connect NetOps tasks beyond static config synthesis and to find evaluation practices for operational reliability.
Locate existing benchmarks and task suites that target networking/AIOps and LLMs to evaluate what metrics and tasks are available and their limitations for operational claims.
Identify threat literature on prompt injection, adversarial inputs, and maliciously-crafted instructions in operational contexts to study attack surfaces for LLM-based NetOps agents.

queries.query: evaluation metrics "operational correctness" "network change" "configuration correctness" "reachability" "isolation" "policy compliance"
queries.rationale: Find papers defining practical correctness metrics (reachability, isolation, access-control policy compliance, performance constraints) and methods to measure them in experiments.

queries.query: simulator OR emulator Mininet ns-3 "network change" "configuration testing" "testbed"
queries.rationale: Identify simulation/emulation platforms and testbeds used to execute or validate configuration changes safely and reproducibly for experimental designs.
Survey empirical work on how operators interact with automated suggestions, acceptance rates, trust, and human verification steps to inform threat-to-validity and mitigation design.
source_preferences: network operations studies in ACM/IEEE venues

queries.rationale: Collect methods that enforce syntactic/semantic constraints on generated artifacts (template-based generation, constrained decoding, schema enforcement) applicable to configs.

queries.query: program synthesis network config "program synthesis" "DSL" "NetKAT" "config synthesis"
queries.rationale: Find work on domain-specific languages, program synthesis, and formal approaches (NetKAT, HSA-based synthesis) that aim to produce correct-by-construction configs and compare to LLM approaches.

queries.query: case study outage "misconfiguration" "network outage" postmortem "configuration change"
queries.rationale: Collect real-world incident reports and postmortems where configuration errors caused outages to understand realistic failure modes and what checks could have prevented them.
source_preferences: Operator postmortems (Cloud providers' blogs with evidence)

queries.query: agentic AI safety OR "autonomous agents" "tool use" "LLM agents" "reliability"
queries.rationale: Survey literature on multi-step agentic LLM systems (tool use, planner-executor architectures) and their reliability, to inform designs of agentic NetOps researchers and guards.

inclusion_criteria: Peer-reviewed conference or journal papers, or widely-cited arXiv preprints with verifiable artifacts (code, data) where available.
Tool papers and reproducible-system documentation (e.g., Batfish, Mininet) with implementation details.
Benchmarks and datasets with public repositories and clear task/metric definitions.
Operator postmortems or case studies that provide technical detail relevant to configuration failures.
Work addressing verification, validation, constrained generation, or safety of automated/scripting approaches in NetOps or adjacent AIOps domains.
exclusion_criteria: Vendor marketing material or product-only whitepapers lacking reproducible evidence.
Non-technical blog posts or news articles unless they contain or link to original technical artifacts or postmortems.
Papers solely benchmarking general LLM knowledge of networking trivia without operational validation or executable artifacts.
Proprietary datasets or closed-source tools that cannot be inspected or reproduced.
Pre-lock development artifacts from the programme (permitted by programme) used as final-study evidence.
date_rationale: Search range: 2010–2026 with priority on 2018–2026. Rationale: seminal network-verification and program-synthesis work (e.g., NetKAT, HSA, Batfish) predates 2018 and must be included, while most LLM, agentic, and AIOps literature is concentrated 2018–2026 (especially 2022–2026). Use latest cutoff up to submission (end of August 2026) and prioritize the most recent high-quality sources and reproducible artifacts.
